messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (truth‑condition) | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|------------------------------------------|--------------------|------------------|--------| | In | locative preposition introducing “all parts” | En | In | OK | | tutte | universal quantifier “all” (∀x Part(x) → …) | ĉiuj | all | OK | | parti | set of spatial divisions of the world | partoj | parts | OK | | impera | He governs each part | imperas | governs | OK | | e | coordinates two predicates | kaj | and | OK | | quivi | locative adverb pointing to the place of reign | tie | there | OK | | regge | He reigns at that place | regas | reigns | OK | | quivi | locative adverb pointing to the place of city/seat | Tie | there | OK | | è | copular verb asserting existence | estas | is | OK | | la | definite article (fem.) marking “city” | — *(omitted)* | (the) | **UNNECESSARY** | | sua | possessive adjective denoting ownership by the Sovereign | lia | his | OK | | città | the Sovereign’s urban domain | urbo | city | OK | | e | coordinates two nouns | kaj | and | OK | | l'alto | article + adjective “the lofty” | la alta | the lofty | OK | | seggio | the Sovereign’s elevated throne | seĝo | seat | OK | | oh | vocative interjection addressing the listener | Ho | O | OK | | felice | describes the emotional state of the chosen one | feliĉa | happy | OK | | colui | pronoun referring to the elected individual | tiu | he/that one | OK | | cu' | relative pronoun introducing the clause “whom … elects” | kiun | whom | OK | | ivi | locative adverb of the place of election | tie | there/thereto | OK | | elegge | He selects the individual at that place | elektas | elects | OK |
---
### Items to Review - **UNNECESSARY**: *la* (definite article before “città”) – Esperanto does not require an article here, so the source article is omitted in the translation.
No missing, wrong, or grammatical‑agreement problems were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
